name: The Battered Ekranoplan
description: A rusted ground-effect craft bought cheap off delta salvagers at Vanga, flown a few metres above the Tethys on a cushion of its own noise.
notes: Wobbles. Came with a Vengi langur nesting in the cargo hold, which nobody found until it reached the emergency fuel shut-off. `vessel` is the kind canon keeps for somewhere that moves and is lived in -- the Kelpfang and the Survival Train are the others.
